points.name: 结果补语“好”：V + 好
points.explainEn: Use V + 好 to mean the action is finished and ready.
points.structure: 动词 + 好

examples.en: The food is ready.
My homework is finished.
Everything is ready.

exercises.q: 填空：饭做___了。
翻译：My homework is finished.
排序：准备 / 都 / 好 / 了 / 东西
exercises.body: 准备 / 都 / 好 / 了 / 东西

points.note: “好”表示动作完成，并常有“已经准备好”的意思。
points.noteEn: 好 marks completion, often with the sense of "ready/done well".

points.name: “一……也/都 + 不/没……”表示完全否定
points.explainEn: Use 一…也/都不/没… to mean “not even one / not at all”.
points.structure: 一 + 量词 + 名词 + 也/都 + 不/没 + 动词

examples.en: I did not eat even one apple.
I am not tired at all today.
He did not say a single word.

exercises.q: 填空：我一个苹果___没吃。
翻译：He did not say a single word.
exercises.body: He did not say a single word.

exercises.q: 改写：我没喝水。（用“一点儿也……”）

points.note: “不”多否定习惯/现在；“没”多否定已经发生的动作。
points.noteEn: 不 negates habits/present states; 没 negates actions that have (not) happened.

points.name: 连词“那”表示“那么/既然这样”
points.explainEn: Use 那 at the start of a reply to mean “then / in that case”.
points.structure: 那 + 句子

examples.en: You are tired? Then take a rest.

examples.zh: 明天下雨？那我们不去了。
examples.en: It will rain tomorrow? Then we will not go.
You have no time? Then see you next time.

exercises.q: 填空：你不舒服？___去医院看看吧。
exercises.body: 你不舒服？___去医院看看吧。

exercises.q: 翻译：Then we will not go.
补全：你今天很忙？___明天再说吧。
exercises.body: 你今天很忙？___明天再说吧。

points.note: 这里“那”不是指示代词“that”，而是承接前文结果。
points.noteEn: Here 那 is not the demonstrative "that"; it links to the previous statement.

points.name: “……了，就……”表示两个动作连续发生
points.explainEn: Use …了，就… when one action happens and the next action follows soon after.
points.structure: 动作1 + 了，就 + 动作2

examples.en: I will go to school after I eat.
He goes home after work.
Call me when you arrive.

exercises.q: 填空：我吃___饭就去学校。
翻译：Call me when you arrive.
排序：就 / 下了班 / 他 / 回家
exercises.body: 就 / 下了班 / 他 / 回家

points.note: 两个动作按时间先后排列，第二个动作紧接着发生。
points.noteEn: The two actions follow time order; the second happens right after the first.

points.name: 简单趋向补语“V + 来 / 去”
points.explainEn: Use 来 for movement toward the speaker, and 去 for movement away from the speaker.
points.structure: 动词 + 来 / 去

examples.en: Please come in.
He walked out.
Bring the book here.

exercises.q: 填空：请进___。
选择：把书带到说话人这里，用“拿（来 / 去）”。
exercises.body: 把书带到说话人这里，用“拿（来 / 去）”。

exercises.q: 翻译：He walked out.

points.note: 地点宾语常放在“来/去”前：回学校去；事物宾语位置较灵活。
points.noteEn: A place object goes before 来/去 (回学校去); a thing object is more flexible.

points.name: 反问句“能……吗？”
points.explainEn: Use 能…吗？ as a rhetorical question. It often means the opposite of the words inside.
points.structure: 能 + 肯定/否定 + 吗？

examples.en: It is so late—how could you not be tired?

examples.zh: 他每天都学习，能不进步吗？
examples.en: He studies every day—how could he not improve?
How could I not know this?

exercises.q: 填空：他天天运动，___不健康吗？
翻译：How could I not know this?
exercises.body: How could I not know this?

exercises.q: 选择：反问“当然会累”可说“能不累（吗 / 呢）？”
exercises.body: 反问“当然会累”可说“能不累（吗 / 呢）？”

points.note: 反问不是在真正提问，而是强调说话人的判断。
points.noteEn: A rhetorical question isn't a real question; it stresses the speaker's judgement.

points.name: “还是”和“或者”的区别
points.explainEn: Use 还是 in a question with choices. Use 或者 in a statement.
points.structure: 问句：A 还是 B？；陈述句：A 或者 B

examples.en: Do you drink tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 我们坐地铁或者坐公共汽车都可以。
examples.en: We can take the subway or the bus.
Are you going today or tomorrow?

exercises.q: 填空：你吃米饭___面条？
填空：今天___明天去都可以。
翻译：Do you want tea or coffee?
exercises.body: Do you want tea or coffee?

points.note: 最简单记法：有选择的疑问句用“还是”；陈述句常用“或者”。
points.noteEn: Simple rule: use 还是 in choice questions, 或者 in statements.

points.name: 存在句：“地点 + V着 + 名词”
points.explainEn: Use place + V着 + noun to say something exists in a place and stays in a state.
points.structure: 地点 + 动词 + 着 + 名词

examples.en: There is a book on the table.
There is a photo hanging on the wall.
There is a person standing at the door.

exercises.q: 填空：桌子上放___一本书。
翻译：There is a person standing at the door.
exercises.body: There is a person standing at the door.

exercises.q: 排序：一张照片 / 墙上 / 挂着
exercises.body: 一张照片 / 墙上 / 挂着

points.note: 重点是“存在 + 持续状态”，不是强调动作正在进行。
points.noteEn: The point is existence + a lasting state, not an action in progress.

points.name: “会”表示可能
points.explainEn: Use 会 to say something is likely or possible to happen.
points.structure: 会 + 动词 / 形容词

examples.en: It may rain tomorrow.
He will probably come.
It may be a little cold at night.

exercises.q: 填空：明天___下雨。
翻译：He will probably come.
改成可能：晚上很冷。

points.note: 这里“会”表示可能，不是“会说汉语”的技能意义。
points.noteEn: Here 会 means likelihood, not the "know how to" sense (as in 会说汉语).

lessons.title: 她总是笑着跟客人说话

points.name: “又……又……”表示两个特点同时存在
points.explainEn: Use 又…又… to say someone or something has two qualities at the same time.
points.structure: 又 + 形容词/动词 + 又 + 形容词/动词

examples.en: This apple is big and sweet.
She is pretty and warm-hearted.

examples.zh: 这个地方又安静又干净。
examples.en: This place is quiet and clean.

exercises.q: 填空：这个苹果___大___甜。
翻译：This place is quiet and clean.
exercises.a: 这个地方又安静又干净。
exercises.body: This place is quiet and clean.

exercises.q: 排序：又 / 她 / 又 / 漂亮 / 热情
exercises.body: 又 / 她 / 又 / 漂亮 / 热情

points.note: 两个部分一般是相同词性的特点或动作。
points.noteEn: The two parts are usually features/actions of the same word class.

points.name: 伴随动作：“V1着（O1）+ V2（O2）”
points.explainEn: Use V1着 + V2 when one action is the manner/background of another action.

examples.en: She speaks with a smile.
He watches TV while sitting.
The teacher came in holding a book.

exercises.q: 填空：她笑___说话。
翻译：He watches TV while sitting.
排序：书 / 老师 / 拿着 / 进来了
exercises.body: 书 / 老师 / 拿着 / 进来了

points.note: V1是伴随状态，V2是主要动作。
points.noteEn: V1 is the accompanying manner/state; V2 is the main action.

points.name: 句末“了”表示情况发生变化
points.explainEn: Use sentence-final 了 to show a new situation or a change.
points.structure: 句子 + 了

examples.en: The weather has become cold.
I do not drink coffee anymore.
He is a teacher now.

exercises.q: 填空：天气冷___。
翻译：I do not drink coffee anymore.
exercises.body: I do not drink coffee anymore.

exercises.q: 改写：他现在是老师。（强调变化）
exercises.body: 他现在是老师。（强调变化）

points.note: 重点是“现在和以前不一样了”。
points.noteEn: The point is "things are different from before now".

points.name: “越来越……”表示变化不断发展
points.explainEn: Use 越来越 + adjective/mental verb to mean “more and more…”.
points.structure: 越来越 + 形容词 / 心理动词

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
His Chinese is getting better and better.

examples.zh: 我越来越喜欢这个城市了。
examples.en: I like this city more and more.

exercises.q: 填空：天气___冷了。
翻译：His Chinese is getting better and better.
exercises.body: His Chinese is getting better and better.

exercises.q: 排序：喜欢 / 我 / 越来越 / 汉语
exercises.body: 喜欢 / 我 / 越来越 / 汉语

points.note: “越来越”后面通常直接接形容词或少数心理动词。
points.noteEn: 越来越 is usually followed directly by an adjective or a few mental verbs.

points.name: 可能补语：“V得 / V不 + 补语”
points.explainEn: Use V得/不 + complement to say an action can or cannot reach a result.
points.structure: 动词 + 得/不 + 结果/趋向补语

examples.en: I can understand this character.
It is too far; I cannot get there on foot.
The sound is too low; I cannot hear it.

exercises.q: 填空：这个字我看___懂。
翻译：I cannot hear it.
选择：太远了，我走（得到 / 不到）。
exercises.body: 太远了，我走（得到 / 不到）。

points.note: 可能补语说“能不能达到结果”，和一般的“能 + 动词”意思接近但结构不同。
points.noteEn: A potential complement says whether a result can be reached; close to 能 + verb but different in structure.

points.name: “名词 + 呢？”询问人或东西在哪里
points.explainEn: Use noun + 呢？ when the context means “Where is …?”.
points.structure: 名词 / 代词 + 呢？

examples.en: Where is my phone?
Where is Teacher Li?
Where is your book?

exercises.q: 填空：我的手机___？
翻译：Where is Teacher Li?
补全：我的书在桌子上。你的书___？
exercises.body: 我的书在桌子上。你的书___？

points.note: 这里“呢”省略了“在哪儿”。
points.noteEn: Here 呢 leaves out "在哪儿 (where)".

points.name: “刚”和“刚才”的区别
points.explainEn: 刚 means “just” and goes before a verb. 刚才 means “just now” and is a time word.
points.structure: 刚 + 动词；刚才 + 句子

examples.en: I just got home.
He called me just now.
I just finished eating.

exercises.q: 填空：我___到学校。
填空：___他还在这儿。
翻译：I just finished eating.

points.note: “刚”是副词；“刚才”是时间名词，可以放在主语前。
points.noteEn: 刚 is an adverb; 刚才 is a time noun and can go before the subject.

points.name: 时段的表达：动作持续多长时间
points.explainEn: Put a duration after the verb to say how long an action or state lasts.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 +（了）+ 时段 +（了）

examples.en: I have studied Chinese for three years.
He lived in Beijing for two years.
I waited for you for ten minutes.

exercises.q: 填空：我学汉语三年___。
翻译：I waited for you for ten minutes.
exercises.body: I waited for you for ten minutes.

exercises.q: 排序：住了 / 他 / 两年 / 北京 / 在
exercises.body: 住了 / 他 / 两年 / 北京 / 在

points.note: “时段”表示长度，如十分钟、两个月、三年。
points.noteEn: A duration shows length, e.g. ten minutes, two months, three years.

points.name: “对……感兴趣”表示兴趣
points.explainEn: Use 对…感兴趣 to say “be interested in…”.
points.structure: 对 + 人/事物 + 感兴趣

examples.zh: 我对中国文化很感兴趣。
examples.en: I am very interested in Chinese culture.
He is interested in music.
What are you interested in?

exercises.q: 填空：我___中国文化很感兴趣。
翻译：He is interested in music.
排序：什么 / 你 / 感兴趣 / 对
exercises.body: 什么 / 你 / 感兴趣 / 对

points.note: “感兴趣”前常用介词“对”引出对象。
points.noteEn: Use 对 before 感兴趣 to introduce what you're interested in.

points.name: 用“半、刻、差”表示时间
points.explainEn: Use 半 for half past, 刻 for a quarter, and 差 for minutes before the next hour.
points.structure: X点半；X点一刻；差X分/一刻Y点

examples.en: It is 3:30 now.
We will meet at 4:15.
It is a quarter to five.

exercises.q: 翻译：a quarter past four

points.note: “刻”=15分钟；“差”从下一个整点往前算。
points.noteEn: 刻 = 15 minutes; 差 counts back from the next full hour.

points.name: “又”和“再”表示重复
points.explainEn: Use 又 for a repeated action that already happened. Use 再 for a repeated action in the future.
points.structure: 已经发生：又 + V；未发生：再 + V

examples.zh: 他昨天迟到，今天又迟到了。
examples.en: He was late yesterday and is late again today.

examples.zh: 这本书很好，我想再看一次。
examples.en: This book is good; I want to read it again.

examples.zh: 我昨天去了，明天还要再去。
examples.en: I went yesterday and will go again tomorrow.

exercises.q: 填空：昨天下雨，今天___下雨了。
填空：明天我想___去一次。
选择：已经第二次发生，用（又 / 再）。
exercises.body: 已经第二次发生，用（又 / 再）。

points.note: 简单记：过去/已发生多用“又”；未来/还没发生多用“再”。
points.noteEn: Simple rule: 又 for the past/done, 再 for the future/not yet.

points.name: 疑问代词活用1：“疑问代词 + 就 + 疑问代词”
points.explainEn: Repeat the same question word around 就 to mean “whatever / wherever / whenever…”.
points.structure: 疑问代词 + … + 就 + 疑问代词 + …

examples.en: I will go wherever you go.
I will eat whatever you eat.

examples.zh: 你什么时候来，我就什么时候来。
examples.en: I will come whenever you come.

exercises.q: 填空：你去哪儿，我就___。
翻译：I will eat whatever you eat.
exercises.body: I will eat whatever you eat.

exercises.q: 补全：你什么时候走，我就___。

points.note: 前后通常使用同一个疑问代词；此时不是真正提问。
points.noteEn: The same question word appears twice; it isn't a real question.

lessons.title: 她的汉语说得跟中国人一样好

points.name: “越A越B”表示两个变化一起发展
points.explainEn: Use 越 A 越 B to mean “the more A, the more B”.
points.structure: 越 + A + 越 + B

examples.zh: 天气越冷，我越想喝热茶。
examples.en: The colder it gets, the more I want hot tea.
The more he talks, the faster he speaks.
The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.

exercises.q: 翻译：The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.
exercises.body: The more I study Chinese, the more interesting it becomes.

exercises.q: 排序：越 / 天气 / 越 / 冷 / 我 / 不想出门
exercises.a: 天气越冷，我越不想出门。
exercises.body: 越 / 天气 / 越 / 冷 / 我 / 不想出门

points.note: 两个“越”后面的内容可以是动作，也可以是状态。
points.noteEn: After each 越 you can have either an action or a state.

points.name: 比较句1：“A 跟 B 一样（+ 形容词）”
points.explainEn: Use A 跟 B 一样 (+ adjective) to say A and B are the same.
points.structure: A + 跟 + B + 一样 +（形容词）

examples.en: He is as tall as I am.
This one is as expensive as that one.

examples.zh: 她说汉语跟老师一样好。
examples.en: She speaks Chinese as well as the teacher.

exercises.q: 填空：他___我一样高。
翻译：This one is as expensive as that one.
exercises.body: This one is as expensive as that one.

exercises.q: 排序：一样 / 她 / 我 / 忙 / 跟
exercises.body: 一样 / 她 / 我 / 忙 / 跟

points.note: “一样”后可直接结束，也可再加形容词说明哪方面一样。
points.noteEn: 一样 can end the clause or be followed by an adjective saying how they're alike.

points.name: 比较句2：“A 比 B + Adj + 一点儿/一些/得多/多了”
points.explainEn: Use 比 to compare. Add 一点儿/一些 for a small difference, and 得多/多了 for a big difference.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 + 一点儿/一些/得多/多了

examples.en: Today is a little colder than yesterday.
Math is much harder than history.

examples.zh: 这件衣服比那件贵一些。
examples.en: This clothing is a little more expensive than that one.

exercises.q: 填空：今天比昨天冷___。
翻译：Math is much harder than history.
exercises.body: Math is much harder than history.

exercises.q: 选择：差别很大用“高（一点儿 / 得多）”。
exercises.body: 差别很大用“高（一点儿 / 得多）”。

points.note: “很/非常”一般不能直接放在“比”字句的形容词前。
points.noteEn: 很/非常 normally can't go before the adjective in a 比 sentence.

points.name: 概数1：“一两个、两三天”等相邻数字
points.explainEn: Put two nearby numbers together to mean an approximate amount.
points.structure: 相邻数字 + 量词/名词

examples.en: I will wait one or two minutes.
He will return in two or three days.
I have about four or five Chinese friends.

exercises.q: 翻译：two or three days
写中文：about four or five people

points.note: 一般使用相邻数字，如“一两、两三、四五”。
points.noteEn: Use adjacent numbers, e.g. 一两, 两三, 四五.

points.name: “把”字句1：A 把 B + V + ……
points.explainEn: Use 把 to put a specific object before the verb and show what happens to it.
points.structure: A + 把 + B + 动词 + 其他成分

examples.en: Please close the door.
I finished the homework.
Do not forget to turn off the air conditioner.

exercises.q: 填空：请___门关了。
翻译：I finished the homework.
排序：把 / 我 / 作业 / 写完了
exercises.body: 把 / 我 / 作业 / 写完了

points.note: “把”后的宾语通常是明确、已知的事物；动词后一般不能什么都没有。
points.noteEn: The 把 object is usually definite/known, and the verb can't stand bare afterwards.

points.name: 概数2：“左右”表示大约
points.explainEn: Put 左右 after a number to mean “about / around”.
points.structure: 数字/数量 + 左右

examples.en: I will arrive at around eight.
There are about twenty people here.
He is around thirty years old.

exercises.q: 填空：我八点___到。
翻译：about twenty people
排序：左右 / 他 / 三十岁
exercises.body: 左右 / 他 / 三十岁

points.note: “左右”放在数量表达后面。
points.noteEn: 左右 goes after the quantity.

lessons.title: 把重要的东西放在我这儿吧

points.name: “才”和“就”的区别
points.explainEn: 才 often means “not until / only then / late”. 就 often means “already / as early as / quickly”.
points.structure: 时间/条件 + 才/就 + 动词

examples.en: He did not get up until nine.
He got up as early as six.
I waited half an hour before he came.

exercises.q: 填空：他九点___起床。
填空：他六点___来了。
翻译：I waited half an hour before he came.
exercises.body: I waited half an hour before he came.

points.note: “才”常让人感觉晚、慢、少；“就”常让人感觉早、快、容易。
points.noteEn: 才 feels late/slow/few; 就 feels early/fast/easy.

points.name: “把”字句2：把 B + V + 在/到/给……
points.explainEn: Use 把 when an action moves an object to a place or person.
points.structure: A + 把 + B + V + 在/到/给 + 地点/人

examples.en: Please put the book on the table.
I sent the photo to my friend.

examples.zh: 他把杯子拿到厨房去了。
examples.en: He took the cup to the kitchen.

exercises.q: 填空：请把书放___桌子上。
翻译：I sent the photo to my friend.
exercises.body: I sent the photo to my friend.

exercises.q: 排序：照片 / 我 / 把 / 发给 / 朋友了
exercises.body: 照片 / 我 / 把 / 发给 / 朋友了

points.note: 本课重点是“把”字句后出现地点或接受者：在、到、给。
points.noteEn: Focus: the 把 sentence with a place or recipient after the verb: 在/到/给.

points.name: 复合趋向补语
points.explainEn: Use a direction word + 来/去 after a verb to show a more specific direction.
points.structure: V + 上/下/进/出/回/过/起 + 来/去

examples.en: Please walk in.
He ran out.
I brought the book back.

exercises.q: 填空：请走进___。
翻译：He ran out.
选择：把书带回说话人这里 → 拿回（来 / 去）。
exercises.body: 把书带回说话人这里 → 拿回（来 / 去）。

points.note: “来”朝说话人方向，“去”离开说话人方向。
points.noteEn: 来 is toward the speaker; 去 is away from the speaker.

points.name: “一边……一边……”表示同时做两件事
points.explainEn: Use 一边…一边… for two actions happening at the same time.
points.structure: 一边 + V1，一边 + V2

examples.zh: 我一边吃饭，一边看电视。
examples.en: I eat while watching TV.

examples.zh: 她一边走路，一边听音乐。
examples.en: She listens to music while walking.

examples.zh: 我们一边喝茶，一边聊天。
examples.en: We drink tea and chat at the same time.

exercises.q: 填空：我___吃饭，___看电视。
翻译：She listens to music while walking.
exercises.a: 她一边走路，一边听音乐。
exercises.body: She listens to music while walking.

exercises.q: 排序：一边 / 我们 / 聊天 / 一边 / 喝茶
exercises.a: 我们一边喝茶，一边聊天。
exercises.body: 一边 / 我们 / 聊天 / 一边 / 喝茶

points.note: 两个动作通常可以同时进行。
points.noteEn: The two actions usually happen at the same time.

points.name: “把”字句3：把 B + V + 结果/趋向补语
points.explainEn: Use 把 + object + verb + result/direction complement to show the result or movement of the object.
points.structure: A + 把 + B + V + 结果补语/趋向补语

examples.en: Please bring the fruit over here.
I cleaned the room.
He finished the homework.

exercises.q: 填空：请把水果拿___。
翻译：I cleaned the room.
排序：作业 / 他 / 把 / 做完了
exercises.body: 作业 / 他 / 把 / 做完了

points.note: 本课强调“把”字句中的结果补语或趋向补语。
points.noteEn: Focus: a result or directional complement in the 把 sentence.

points.name: “先……，再/又……，然后……”表示动作顺序
points.explainEn: Use 先…再/又…然后… to show the order of several actions.
points.structure: 先 + V1，再/又 + V2，然后 + V3

examples.en: First I eat, then I do homework.
Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.zh: 他先去了商店，又去了银行，然后回家。
examples.en: He first went to the shop, then the bank, and then went home.

exercises.q: 填空：我___吃饭，___做作业。
翻译：Wash your hands first, then eat.
exercises.body: Wash your hands first, then eat.

exercises.q: 排序：然后 / 回家 / 先 / 我 / 买东西
exercises.body: 然后 / 回家 / 先 / 我 / 买东西

points.note: “再”常用于下一步；“又”可用于叙述已经发生的第二个动作。
points.noteEn: 再 is for the next step; 又 can narrate a second action that already happened.

points.name: “除了……以外，都/还/也……”表示范围
points.explainEn: Use 除了…以外 to mean “except for…” or “besides…”. 都 shows exception; 还/也 adds something.
points.structure: 除了 + X + 以外，其他 + 都… / 还/也…

examples.zh: 除了我以外，大家都来了。
examples.en: Everyone came except me.

examples.zh: 除了汉语以外，我还学英语。
examples.en: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

examples.zh: 除了苹果，我也喜欢西瓜。
examples.en: Besides apples, I also like watermelon.

exercises.q: 填空：除了我___，大家都来了。
翻译：Besides Chinese, I also study English.
exercises.a: 除了汉语以外，我还学英语。
exercises.body: Besides Chinese, I also study English.

exercises.q: 选择：表示“除他之外大家都来”用“除了他以外，大家（都 / 还）来了”。
exercises.body: 表示“除他之外大家都来”用“除了他以外，大家（都 / 还）来了”。

points.note: “都”常表示排除一个范围；“还/也”常表示在原有内容上增加。
points.noteEn: 都 excludes (except…); 还/也 add one more item.

points.name: 疑问代词活用2：“什么”表示不确定的人或事物
points.explainEn: Use 什么 in a non-question to mean “something / anything” when the thing is not specific.
points.structure: （没）什么 + 名词 / 有什么 + 名词

examples.en: I do not have any questions.
Would you like something to drink?
If there is anything, call me.

exercises.q: 填空：我没___问题。
翻译：Would you like something to drink?
exercises.body: Would you like something to drink?

exercises.q: 补全：有___事可以告诉我。

points.note: 这里“什么”不是要求一个确定答案，而表示不确定的人或事物。
points.noteEn: Here 什么 doesn't ask for a definite answer; it means "something/anything".

points.name: “极了”表示程度很高
points.explainEn: Put 极了 after an adjective to mean “extremely / very”.
points.structure: 形容词 + 极了

examples.en: It is extremely hot today.
This place is extremely beautiful.
He is extremely happy.

exercises.q: 填空：今天热___。
翻译：This place is extremely beautiful.
排序：高兴 / 他 / 极了

points.note: “极了”放在形容词后面，程度比“很”强。
points.noteEn: 极了 goes after an adjective and is stronger than 很.

lessons.title: 我现在累得下了班就想睡觉

points.name: “如果……（的话），就……”表示条件
points.explainEn: Use 如果…就… to mean “if… then…”. 的话 can be added after the condition.
points.structure: 如果 + 条件 +（的话），主语 + 就 + 结果

examples.zh: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.

examples.zh: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
examples.en: If you are tired, take a rest.

examples.zh: 如果有时间的话，我就去看你。
examples.en: If I have time, I will go see you.

exercises.q: 填空：___明天下雨，我们___不去了。
翻译：If you are tired, take a rest.
exercises.a: 如果你累了，就休息一下。
exercises.body: If you are tired, take a rest.

exercises.q: 补全：如果有时间___，我就去。

points.note: “的话”可以省略，但“如果……就……”是最清楚的基本结构。
points.noteEn: 的话 can be dropped, but 如果…就… is the clearest basic pattern.

points.name: 复杂的状态补语：“形容词/动词 + 得 + 动词词组”
points.explainEn: Use adjective/verb + 得 + a phrase to show a strong degree and its result.
points.structure: 形容词/动词 + 得 + 动词词组/小句

examples.en: I am so tired that I do not want to talk.
He is so busy that he has no time to eat.
The child is so happy that he sings and jumps.

exercises.q: 填空：我累___不想说话。
翻译：He is so busy that he has no time to eat.
exercises.body: He is so busy that he has no time to eat.

exercises.q: 排序：高兴 / 孩子 / 又唱又跳 / 得
exercises.body: 高兴 / 孩子 / 又唱又跳 / 得

points.note: “得”后面不是简单形容词，而可以是一整个短语或小句。
points.noteEn: After 得 you can have a whole phrase or clause, not just one adjective.

points.name: 单音节形容词重叠：“AA的”
points.explainEn: Repeat a one-syllable adjective as AA的 to describe a vivid characteristic.
points.structure: 单音节形容词 + 重叠 + 的

examples.en: Her eyes are big.
This child is chubby.
She has long hair.

exercises.q: 填空：她的眼睛大___的。
翻译：She has long hair.
把“白”变成重叠形式。

points.note: 常用来描写外貌和事物特点，语气生动。
points.noteEn: Often describes looks and features, in a vivid tone.

lessons.title: 谁都有办法看好你的“病”

points.name: 双音节动词重叠：“ABAB”
points.explainEn: Repeat a two-syllable verb as ABAB to mean doing it briefly or trying it.
points.structure: 双音节动词 AB → ABAB

examples.en: Let us rest for a while.

examples.zh: 你介绍介绍这个地方吧。
examples.en: Please introduce this place a little.
I want to practice Chinese for a bit.

exercises.q: 把“休息”变成重叠形式。
翻译：Let us practice Chinese for a bit.
exercises.body: Let us practice Chinese for a bit.

exercises.q: 填空：你给我介绍___这个地方吧。
exercises.body: 你给我介绍___这个地方吧。

points.note: 双音节动词一般用ABAB，不说AABB。
points.noteEn: Two-syllable verbs reduplicate as ABAB, not AABB.

points.name: 疑问代词活用3：疑问代词 + 都/也……表示任指
points.explainEn: Use 谁/什么/哪儿/怎么 + 都/也 to mean “everyone / everything / anywhere / any way”.
points.structure: 疑问代词 + 都/也 + 谓语

examples.en: Everyone likes her.
I eat everything.
We can go anywhere.

exercises.q: 填空：___都喜欢这个老师。
翻译：I eat everything.
补全：我们___都可以。

points.note: 这些疑问代词不表示疑问，而表示一个范围里的“每一个/任何一个”。
points.noteEn: Here the question words aren't questions; they mean "every/any one".

points.name: “只要……，就……”表示充分条件
points.explainEn: Use 只要…就… to mean “as long as… then…”.
points.structure: 只要 + 条件，就 + 结果

examples.en: As long as you work hard, you will improve.
As long as it does not rain, we will go.
As long as I have time, I exercise.

exercises.q: 填空：___你努力，___会进步。
翻译：As long as it does not rain, we will go.
exercises.body: As long as it does not rain, we will go.

exercises.q: 补全：只要有时间，我___运动。

points.note: “只要”强调这个条件一满足，后面的结果就可以发生。
points.noteEn: 只要 stresses that once the condition is met, the result can happen.

points.name: 介词“关于”表示“关于/有关”
points.explainEn: Use 关于 before a topic to mean “about / concerning”.
points.structure: 关于 + 话题 +（的）+ 名词/句子

examples.zh: 关于这个问题，我想再说几句。
examples.en: I want to say a little more about this question.

examples.zh: 这是一本关于中国文化的书。
examples.en: This is a book about Chinese culture.

examples.zh: 关于明天的考试，老师说了很多。
examples.en: The teacher said a lot about tomorrow’s test.

exercises.q: 填空：___这个问题，我想说两句。
翻译：a book about Chinese culture
exercises.a: 一本关于中国文化的书

exercises.q: 排序：关于 / 老师 / 考试 / 说了很多
exercises.a: 老师关于考试说了很多。
exercises.body: 关于 / 老师 / 考试 / 说了很多

points.note: “关于 + 话题”常放在句首；修饰名词时常用“关于……的 + 名词”。
points.noteEn: 关于 + topic often opens the sentence; to modify a noun use 关于…的 + noun.

points.name: 趋向补语的引申义：“出来 / 下来 / 起来”
points.explainEn: Direction complements can have extended meanings: 出来 can show creation/recognition, 下来 a change becoming calmer/slower, and 起来 recalling.
points.structure: V + 出来 / Adj-V + 下来 / V + 起来

examples.en: I came up with a good idea.
Did you recognize who he is?
I remembered his name.

exercises.q: 填空：我终于想___他的名字了。
翻译：Did you recognize who he is?
exercises.body: Did you recognize who he is?

exercises.q: 选择：车慢（下来 / 出来）了。

points.note: HSK3重点掌握“出来=产生/识别”，“下来=状态由强到弱/由动到静”，“起来=回忆有结果”。
points.noteEn: Focus: 出来 = produce/identify, 下来 = fading/settling, 起来 = successful recall.

points.name: “使、叫、让”表示致使
points.explainEn: Use 使/叫/让 + person/thing + verb/adjective to mean “make / let”.
points.structure: 使 / 叫 / 让 + 人/事物 + 谓语

examples.en: This makes me very happy.
Mom makes/asks me to go home early.
Exercise makes the body healthier.

exercises.q: 填空：这件事___我很高兴。
翻译：Exercise makes the body healthier.
选择：口语中“让/叫”常见，书面语中（使 / 呢）更常见。
exercises.body: 口语中“让/叫”常见，书面语中（使 / 呢）更常见。

points.note: “使”较书面；“叫、让”更口语。三者都可以表示“使某人/某物产生某种结果”。
points.noteEn: 使 is more formal; 叫/让 are colloquial; all mean "cause someone/something to…".

points.name: “被”字句表示被动
points.explainEn: Use 被 to say the subject receives an action: “be done by…”.
points.structure: A + 被 + B + 动词 + 其他成分

examples.en: My apple was eaten by my younger brother.
The door was opened by the wind.
My book was taken away by him.

exercises.q: 填空：我的苹果___弟弟吃了。
翻译：My book was taken away by him.
exercises.body: My book was taken away by him.

exercises.q: 排序：被 / 门 / 风 / 打开了
exercises.body: 被 / 门 / 风 / 打开了

points.note: HSK3先掌握最基本结构；否定通常用“没（有）被……”。
points.noteEn: Learn the basic pattern first; the negative is usually 没(有)被….

points.name: “只有……，才……”表示必要条件
points.explainEn: Use 只有…才… to mean “only if… then…”. The first condition is necessary.
points.structure: 只有 + 条件，才 + 结果

examples.zh: 只有多练习，汉语才会进步。
examples.en: Only with more practice will your Chinese improve.
Only if you have a ticket can you go in.

examples.zh: 只有周末，我才有时间运动。
examples.en: Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.

exercises.q: 填空：___多练习，汉语___会进步。
翻译：Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.
exercises.a: 只有周末，我才有时间运动。
exercises.body: Only on weekends do I have time to exercise.

exercises.q: 补全：只有有票，___能进去。

points.note: “只要……就……”=条件够了就行；“只有……才……”=这个条件是必须的。
points.noteEn: 只要…就… = enough condition; 只有…才… = a necessary condition.
